summary: Petition under Regulation 17(3) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021, seeking approval of the Commission to appoint an Independent Director on the Board of Power Exchange India Limited. Power Exchange India Limited Inizio, 101-104, 1[st] Floor, Cardinal Gracious Road, Chakala, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400 093, India **Petitioner** The Petitioner, Power Exchange India Limited (hereinafter referred to as “PXIL”) has filed the present petition under Regulation 17 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021 (hereinafter referred to as “PMR 2021”), seeking approval of the Commission to appoint an Independent Director on the Board of PXIL. The Board of PXIL has recommended two names, Dr. Indu Shekhar Jha and Mr. Paresh Vasant Bambolkar (hereinafter collectively referred to as “the candidates”), for consideration by the Commission for appointment on the Board of PXIL as Independent Director. PXIL has also filed the brief profile, declaration under Section 149(7) read with Section 149(6) of the Companies Act, 2013, details in “Form MBP-1”, “Form DIR-2”, and “Form DIR-8” of the Companies Act, 2013, and affidavits of both the candidates for appointment of as an Independent Director, in terms of Regulations 17(4) of PMR 2021. The petitioner has filed the present petition with the following prayers: - _“ a. Accord approval to the proposal of the Petitioner to appoint any candidate as Independent Director whose names and particulars are placed at hereto, in terms of Regulation 17(3) of the 2021 Regulations;_ - _c. Pass any other or further orders as this Hon’ble Commission deems fit and necessary in the interest of justice. ”_ - _(1) The Board of Directors of the Power Exchange shall have the following categories of Directors:-_ - _(3) A minimum of two names shall be submitted by the Board of the Power Exchange to the Commission for approval for each vacancy of Independent Directors._ - _(4) The Power Exchange shall ensure that Independent Directors are selected from diverse fields of work and while deciding to propose name of a particular person as an Independent Director, the Power Exchange shall also take into account the following factors:_ - _(e) Persons who are Directors in the board of the promoter entity of the Power Exchange, shall be excluded;_ - _(11) No member of Power Exchange or their client shall be on the Board of Directors of any Power Exchange._ - _(12) The Power Exchanges which have been granted registration by the Commission prior to the date of coming into force of these regulations, shall within a period not exceeding one year from the date of coming into force of these regulations, align the governance structure as specified in this Regulation.”_ 5. Further, Section 149(6) of the Companies Act, 2013 provides for the appointment _(i) holds or has held the position of a key managerial personnel or is or has been employee of the company or its holding, subsidiary or associate company in any of the three financial years immediately preceding the financial year in which he is proposed to be appointed;_ _under this clause shall not apply for his employment during preceding three financial years._ _(ii) is or has been an employee or proprietor or a partner, in any of the three financial years immediately preceding the financial year in which he is proposed to be appointed, of—_ 8. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. At the time of filing of the present petition, the Petitioner had four (4) Shareholder Directors, one (1) Managing Director & CEO, and four (4) Independent Directors on the Board of PXIL. The composition of the Board of Directors of PXIL as on 18.02.2026, as provided by the Petitioner, is as under: 10. As per Regulation 17(3) of the PMR 2021, the Board of a Power Exchange is required to submit at least two names to the Commission for approval for each vacancy of Independent Directors . Accordingly, the Board of the Petitioner has approved two names, viz. Dr. Indu Shekhar Jha and Mr. Paresh Vasant Bambolkar proposed for appointment to the position of Independent Director. Therefore, in compliance with the requirement as provided under Regulation 17(1), 17(2) and 17(3) of PMR 2021, the Petitioner has preferred the present petition seeking approval for the appointment of one (1) Independent Director on its board from the abovementioned names. A brief of their profiles is as follows: 11. The Petitioner has also placed on record the affidavits submitted by Dr. Indu Shekhar Jha (DIN: 00015615) and Mr. Paresh Vasant Bambolkar (DIN: 00260136). Both the candidates have affirmed that they do not have any conflict of interest in the commercial contracts and financial affairs of PXIL; they do not have any fiduciary relationship with any member of the Petitioner; they do not hold a directorial position in the Board of the promoter entity of PXIL; and they have not suffered from any disqualification prescribed under PMR 2021 for consideration for appointment or continuation as an Independent Director of the Power Exchange. Further, Dr. Indu Shekhar Jha has also undertaken that even in the case of approval of his appointment as an Independent Director, he shall not join or assume charge of the said position until the completion of the prescribed cooling-off period, as applicable under the Electricity Act, 2003, and rules/regulations framed thereunder. 13. The proposal of the Petitioner for the appointment of an Independent Director on its Board has been considered in light of PMR 2021. The Commission finds that there is currently one (1) vacancy for an Independent Director on the Board of PXIL. We have perused the documents on record and profiles of Dr. Indu Shekhar Jha and Mr. Paresh Vasant Bambolkar and after being confirmed by PXIL that they do not have any fiduciary Order in Petition No. 143/RC/2026 Page **9** of **9** CERC Website S.
